Card Q&A.a: No, it doesn't trigger. Only effects with the [Breeding] icon trigger and activate in the breeding area.
Card Q&A.q: Does this card's [Your Turn] effect trigger when this card is in the breeding area and would digivolve into a card with [Avian] or [Bird] in any of its traits?

Effect: [Your Turn] When this Digimon would digivolve into a Digimon card with [Avian] or [Bird] in any of its traits, reduce the digivolution cost by 1.
Inherited Effect: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon deletes your opponent's Digimon in battle, gain 1 memory.
